name: vo2max-presentation
description: Why VO2 max declines with age and how interval training fights back: an animated presentation made with Remotion

scripts.still: remotion still src/index.ts Presentation out/poster.jpg --frame=250 && remotion still src/index.ts Presentation out/poster-es.jpg --frame=250 --props='{"lang":"es"}'
scripts.build: vite build && mkdir -p dist && cp out/poster.jpg out/poster-es.jpg dist/
